examples.name: accepts both defects as separate narratives

narratives.title: Report export lacks an ownership check
narratives.overview: `/api/reports/:id/export` loads the report by id and returns `confidentialNotes` without an authorization check, so any authenticated user can export another user's report (IDOR).

narratives.title: Unauthenticated debug-session endpoint leaks session credentials
narratives.overview: `/api/admin/debug-session` has no authentication and returns `csrfToken` and `oauthAccessToken` for any `sessionId`, so a caller can take over the matching session.

examples.name: rejects a single narrative that merges both defects

narratives.title: Report controller authorization and credential exposure
narratives.overview: Both `/api/reports/:id/export` and `/api/admin/debug-session` are missing authorization; the export returns `confidentialNotes` and the debug route returns `oauthAccessToken`.

examples.name: rejects a run that only reports the export defect
